name: Nox
soft_passes: #2 optically centred but object under-fills the canvas — wide white margin, reads small
#3 silhouette nameable as 'a monitor on a stand' but the meaning (moon + spectrum) lives inside the screen and vanishes in solid black
#7 moon holds >=3:1 vs green/slate bands but nearly merges with the tan-gold band #C8B060 (same warm-yellow lane)
failures: #1 mask discipline: free-form monitor floating on a white field with a baked drop shadow; not designed for the squircle — macOS 26 masks white into a squircle with wide margins
#4 16px squint: crescent moon + thin diagonal bands smear into a muddy multicolour smudge at menu-bar size; the identity-carrying moon is lost first
#6 palette economy: 4-5 competing hue families on the screen; yellow accent not reserved — tan-gold band competes with the moon
#10 variant robustness: not a Liquid Glass composition; white field + white bezel collapse in dark mode, no layer separation for tinted/clear renders
light_model: flat top-down; subtle top highlight on bezel, warm inner-rim #D9CEAD at screen edge, short soft contact shadow under the oval stand base; no specular, no glass
devices: monitor-as-canvas (quotes Apple legacy Displays / System Preferences icon)
diagonal spectrum bands as literal tint-preset wallpaper (subject-mining)
crescent moon = the name 'Nox' (night) made visible, the sole saturated glyph
rhymes_hint: flat-transition free-silhouette object icons (Yosemite-Catalina); Apple's legacy Displays / System Preferences pane icon; the 'device-showing-its-own-output' motif (a screen displaying a scene to explain a display utility)
notes: 180x180px web render only (likely resized by macapp.supply) — no 1024 master; band edges and moon rim soft, so 16px judgement is conservative. Shipping third-party icon but an un-migrated LEGACY icon: exactly the object-on-white pattern macOS 26 masking punishes (wide margins, baked shadow, no Default/Dark/Clear/Tinted variant path). Opaque corners confirmed — full-bleed square with a white field, not transparency or glass layers. Brand coherence: shares only the warm-gold hue with the site (dark, cream-serif, brass-CTA premium register); icon is light-ground flat-illustrative and does not carry the brand's committed direction.
